implementation.core_integration: LaplaceCore exposes one lazy shared IdleConsolidator and run_idle_consolidation lifecycle adapter; IDLE_START and IDLE_END remain typed hook boundaries.
properties: Deterministic analysis of bounded trajectory and memory snapshots produces episodic summaries, explicitly labelled durable-fact candidates, contradiction/supersession review, duplicate and obsolete-memory demotion review, recurring failures, candidate skills, process improvements and optional code-change proposals.

All proposals are persisted as shadow, human-approval-required records with owner/project scope, source event and memory identifiers, input hash, analyzer and policy provenance; no authoritative memory, skill activation, rules, routing policy or source file is changed.
Candidate harness changes are limited to one explicit bounded candidate per cycle and carry a baseline/candidate, development, held-out, correctness and security evaluation contract.

A/B evidence is hash-bound and deterministic at the ledger boundary; correctness or security regression rejects the candidate, while a pass records awaiting_human_approval. Human approval records human_approved_shadow_only and never promotes or executes the candidate.

Cycle and proposal state uses atomic fsync-and-replace persistence, strict restart validation, idempotent replay, input/scope conflict detection, duplicate proposal de-duplication and crash-safe pre-commit behavior.

Maintenance budgets bound input records and bytes, logical tokens, proposal count, cycle storage, state bytes, minimum interval and cycles per window. No model or GPU work is performed; reported GPU use is exactly zero.
security_boundaries: The module has no subprocess, shell, network, dynamic import, evaluation, document-command execution or unrestricted recursive self-modification path.
Sensitive input keys are rejected before analysis; persisted state is schema-validated and state symlinks are rejected.
No delete or auto-promotion operation exists. Duplicate, contradiction and obsolete findings remain review proposals with delete_allowed false where applicable.
The service accepts typed records or to_json snapshots only and never treats model text as executable instructions.

comparison.method: The frozen suite exercises multiple controlled idle conditions, contradiction and duplicate proposals, a simulated crash and restart, duplicate replay, deterministic A/B pass and security-regression rejection. All candidates remain shadow and the evidence contract includes development and held-out task identifiers.
comparison.reason: The mechanism is a local proposal ledger only. It performs no model/GPU work, does not alter authoritative stores or routing, and requires explicit human approval before a future promotion path.

limitations: G10 certifies the shadow mechanism, not automatic promotion. No production mutation, durable-memory deletion, skill activation, rules change, routing change or source edit is permitted by this phase.
The deterministic ledger records A/B evidence supplied by a verifier; it does not run model rollouts or invent correctness, security, latency or hardware measurements.
The current Core adapter is explicit; existing memory and trajectory call sites are not silently redirected into maintenance.
No G0 certification rerun was performed, per the roadmap instruction and previous certifications.
The socket-concurrency regression requires host socket permission because the restricted shell denies socket creation; the final selected suite passed with that permission.
